title: The Estuary Where Infinite Becomes One Again

features.name: confluence pool
features.desc-on-touch: Three currents meet here and their argument is settled by mixing. The pool is calm because it has won the argument: being one is stronger than being separate.

features.name: branch echo
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph marking the point where one tributary's name is swallowed by the name of another. The smaller echo grows fainter each tide cycle.

features.name: river mouth
features.desc-on-touch: The estuary opens like a throat finally learning its own song. All the divergence has led here, where becoming singular is possible.

inscription: all the divergence learns here what it was traveling toward

file.name: RiverMouths_Infinite_Convergence_1991.mp3
file.note: Hydrophone recording of three tributaries meeting. The moment before sound becomes singular. Three voices learning to be one transmission.

exits.label: the way back up where branches still remember being separate
where the estuary opens to salt and horizon
toward an older convergence still holding its shape
